abap-utilities-demo.summary: Synthetic ABAP source for utilities meter-reading validation and billing estimation, with 77 ABAP Unit methods executed on the open-source abaplint/transpiler stack (all ran without a failed assertion, 0 lint issues). No SAP system was used.
abap-utilities-demo.title: ABAP utilities demo: meter reading validation and billing estimate (tested on abaplint/transpiler)

artist-booking-prototype.summary: Browse fictional artists, choose a package and time, and inspect a simulated booking in customer, artist and admin views. No real payment or reservation.
artist-booking-prototype.title: Artist booking interactive prototype

batch-release-process-intelligence.summary: Process mining, deterministic KPIs and an auditable copilot for pharmaceutical batch review and release: an SAP-style extract (order confirmations, goods receipts, inspection lots, results, deviations, usage decisions) becomes an event log with a data-quality report, outcome-to-process KPI drivers, an explainable maturity score, an intervention pre/post test and traced copilot answers.
batch-release-process-intelligence.title: Pharma Batch Review & Release — Process Intelligence demo

burial-records-archive.summary: Searchable archive of historic ledger records: fuzzy name search, county/year filters, scan viewer, staff CSV import with validation.
burial-records-archive.title: Historic Burial Records Archive

car-raffle-landing-demo.summary: An offline, mobile-first concept raffle with illustrated vehicle slider, editable pricing, live countdown and simulated checkout.
car-raffle-landing-demo.title: Car raffle landing page demo (sample data)

property-development-site-wireframe.summary: A clickable homepage wireframe with linked Location, Homes and Enquiry pages, showing a buyer journey for a property development site. It was built from the public job post on synthetic data, not on client data. It also produces a WordPress page plan and a lead-routing sample.
property-development-site-wireframe.title: Property development site wireframe

sample-business-website-with-seo-checks.summary: A four-page business website sample (Home, About, Services, Contact) with a page map, mobile-friendly HTML templates and an SEO audit. It was built from the public job post on synthetic data, not on client data.
sample-business-website-with-seo-checks.title: Sample business website with SEO checks

small-business-website.summary: Fast, accessible, SEO-ready static site (home, about, services, contact, blog) rebranded from one JSON file.
small-business-website.title: 5-Page Small-Business Website Template

tea-steep-timer.summary: Shopify OS 2.0 product-page section: water temperature, leaf amount and a calm countdown ring with re-steeps and a chime.

tire-inspection-app.summary: Phone/tablet web app for a tire and auto shop: jobs board, work orders, tire/brake/TPMS inspection with photos, and a customer report link.
tire-inspection-app.title: Tire Shop Digital Vehicle Inspection

web-demo.summary: A starter for a custom responsive website, built from the public job post on synthetic data, not on client data. A sample brand spec becomes a written page list and component map, a REST API layer (Flask routes), and one responsive home page built from React-style components.

web-demo-10.summary: A starter design kit for a one-page website: it pulls colour and type cues from a logo into Figma-ready style tokens and draws two distinct low-fidelity wireframe layouts (desktop and mobile). It was built from the public job post on synthetic data (a generated placeholder logo), not on client data.
web-demo-10.title: Web demo

web-demo-11.summary: A minimal local Python web app: a form page sends input to a POST /api/process endpoint, which validates it and returns a JSON summary or structured JSON errors. It was built from the public job post on synthetic data, not on client data. It uses only the Python standard library (a Flask + Pydantic version is a direct port).

web-demo-2.summary: A mobile-first HTML5 page with CSS grid components (header, nav, card grid, footer), built from the public job post on synthetic placeholder content, not on client data. It stands in for a first design screen until the real designs are shared.

web-demo-3.summary: A static, dependency-free PCB company website demo with five sections (product, information, news, industry, culture) plus a China-access dependency checklist. It was built from the public job post on synthetic data, not on client data.

web-demo-4.summary: A static three-page website (Home, About Us, Contact) generated from a design-token file, with a photo carousel built on CSS scroll-snap. It was built from the public job post on synthetic data (placeholder tokens, images and text), not on client data.
web-demo-4.title: Web demo

web-demo-5.summary: A working core for a mobile-first rental marketplace: four categories, five roles, listings, price/location filters, inquiries and an admin moderation queue.
